source.data: LIVE Data.p4k: ObjectContainers (positions) + DataCore starmap records (names, types) + english global.ini

how_to_read.hierarchy: One file per system: solar | planetary.<planet> | lunar.<moon>. Distances between systems are not covered.
how_to_read.solar: Everything in space: star, planets and moons (as points at their centre), stations, Lagrange points, jump-point gateways, asteroid bases, comm arrays. pos_km is relative to the star. Planets and moons do not orbit in-game, so these distances are fixed.
how_to_read.planetary_lunar: Surface locations (less than 100 km altitude) on that body, stored as coordinates only. pos_km is in the body's own frame (centre = 0), so distances between two locations on the same body hold whatever the body's rotation: straight line = |pos_A - pos_B|.
how_to_read.body_distance: Distances to a planet or moon in `solar` are to its centre; subtract radius_km for distance to the surface.
how_to_read.lookup: The file holds coordinates only. The SC_distances skill (dependencies/sc_distance.py) computes any distance from pos_km: space to space exact, same body straight line plus over the ground, and a min-max range for a surface location to anywhere else as the body rotates. By hand: straight line = |pos_A - pos_B| within the same group.
how_to_read.nearest_body: Space locations name the nearest planet or moon and their altitude_km above its surface.
how_to_read.duplicate_names: If a name occurs twice in one group, the label gets the nearest body or a short record id in brackets.
how_to_read.revision: Higher revision = newer data. format changes only when readers must change.

rules.included: Released systems only, one file each. Locations shown in the starmap and placed in the game world in the current LIVE build.
rules.excluded: Starmap-hidden markers, records with no localized name, locations marked NOT CURRENTLY ACCESSIBLE, event-only markers, gateways to unreleased systems, and starmap entries nothing places in the world. What was left out is listed under `excluded`.
